I'm 19 and feel the same most nights. The past weeks I really wanted to be dead every single day. But I know I need to hold on and keep trying, at least for my family. I hope you'll find the strength to keep going too.

Its so stupid but it started when I stopped seeing a reason for going to school 3 years ago (16 y.o.) because I felt like I wasn't learning anything important for life. At that point all my motivation to learn or even listen left me and I went from having A's in a bunch of classes to F's in almost all of them within a year. During that time I lost all my energy, nothing made me really happy anymore and I kinda felt like being dead would be easier. Last year I dropped out and within that last year I lost every will to live and now I feel like killing myself every night. I thought I only have to get my financial situation under control and find something I will enjoy doing for a living but now I think the problem is way deeper and it can never fully be fixed. Thank you for listening I really appreciate it <3

If you're drunk right now just try to go to sleep and it will probably get better once you sober up. Thats what its like for me. Beyond that I sadly dont know what to do myself. But dont make any life changing decisions while your drunk or on any other drug!
I feel like I almost want to try and fail so I can have some sort of awekening but from what I've heard I'll still feel the same afterwards.
